specs.Item Type Name: Ant Globe 25 Dual Mode Wireless Mouse

features: NOTE :- The 2.4GHz wireless receiver is stored inside the mouse. Open the battery/back compartment to remove the receiver before first use.
HYBRID DUAL-MODE CONNECTIVITY – Instantly toggle between Bluetooth and 2.4GHz Wireless modes to control two devices simultaneously, including tablets, smartphones, and laptops
ECO-FRIENDLY RECHARGEABLE POWER – High-capacity internal battery delivers up to 30 hours of peak performance on a single 2-hour charge, featuring a convenient micro-USB charging port
PRECISION OPTICAL TRACKING – Effortlessly switch between 800, 1200, and 1600 DPI for pixel-perfect accuracy on any surface, supported by a high-speed 125Hz polling rate
WHISPER-QUIET & DURABLE CLICKS – Engineered with a silent 4-button layout rated for 3 million clicks, providing a distraction-free environment for libraries, offices, or late-night work
ULTRA-SLIM & PORTABLE DESIGN: The lightweight ABS body and compact profile make it an ideal travel companion that fits easily into laptop bags or pockets
